invocations.note: start; a busy 429 released at no cost and retried after one backoff; a clean cap stop
resume; a reply without usage is held at its worst case and halts the run (exit 3) inside a fresh cell, whose plan had settled
resume; the abandoned cell repeated from its beginning; two busy refusals in a row (30 s, 60 s), then the Worker's own limiter (429 rate-limited); a clean cap stop
resume; five busy refusals in a row exhaust the backoff schedule on a fresh plan, the cell fails as a provider failure, and the monitor kills the invocation at its next spacing wait
resume with --rerun-failed: the failed cell and the refinements skipped for it are superseded and re-run; the run completes
